name: NLS collaborative hypertext system
description: The Stanford Research Institute NLS integrated interactive document navigation, pointing, shared screens and collaboration.

impact.note: Used by one research group; it showed pointing, hypertext and shared-screen work as new abilities, and the graphical interface line drew on it.

date.label: 8–9 December 1968
date.basis: CHM publications disagree on the day; conference programme not yet checked.

events.statement: Engelbart’s team demonstrated NLS in San Francisco, including a mouse, hypertext and remote screen collaboration.

contributions.resource: Led the collaborative NLS research and demonstration.

evidence.supports: CHM describes Engelbart and his team.
CHM dates the demo and identifies the functions.
Preservation history attributes the system to the SRI ARC team.
The museum magazine dates the demonstration to 8 December 1968.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated event established in the cited sources for this scoped record; it does not assert global priority.

caveats: The conference demonstration does not date the invention of each component or establish general public use; some CHM material gives 8 December and the exact date should be checked against the conference programme.

research.note: Source-backed initial research; independent review is pending.
